statements.markdown: **Theorem 1.2 (a weighted condition on the support).** *Let $b\ge2$ be an integer, let $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0}$ be infinite, and let $P$ be a finite nonempty set of primes. Set $h(a)=\prod_{p\in P}p^{v_p(a)}$. If* $$ W_{b,P}(A):=\sum_{a\in A} \frac{h(a)}{a(b^{h(a)}-1)}<\infty, \tag{1} $$ *then $X_A(b)$ is irrational. In particular, the base-two condition* $$ \sum_{a\in A}\frac{h(a)}{a(2^{h(a)}-1)}<\infty \tag{W} $$ *implies that $X_A(b)$ is irrational for every integer $b\ge2$. Both conclusions are hereditary under passage to infinite subsets.*
